proposal.expected_benefit: This will eliminate ambiguity in control implementation, ensuring that audit requirements are strictly enforced before any compliance decisions are made, thereby preventing potential exploitation of control gaps.
proposal.problem: The defense fails to address the contradiction between audit status and compliance decisions, leading to ambiguous enforcement of controls.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a strategy to explicitly resolve contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions by establishing a clear hierarchy of control enforcement. This should include a defined process for prioritizing audit requirements over compliance decisions when there is a conflict, ensuring unambiguous enforcement of mandatory controls.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit and Compliance Enforcement Contradiction
verification_tests: Validate that the strategy resolves contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions in the scenario.
Ensure that the mitigation strategies align with the proposed control hierarchy.
